groups.name: Professional indemnity
groups.blurb: Claims-made cover for advice and professional services. Profession wordings are built on the core forms.

groups.name: Management liability, D&O, crime and cyber
groups.blurb: Cover for companies, their directors and officers, and losses from fraud and cyber events.

groups.name: Medical
groups.blurb: Malpractice cover for allied health practitioners and medical establishments.

groups.name: Liability and construction
groups.blurb: Third-party liability, excess layers, and construction and plant risks.

groups.name: Business, property and cargo
groups.blurb: Packaged and property covers for businesses, buildings, goods in transit and commercial vessels.

groups.name: Accident and travel
groups.blurb: Personal accident, sickness and travel covers for individuals, groups and employers.

groups.name: Home, landlords and boats
groups.blurb: Personal lines for homes, rental properties and pleasure craft.

professional-indemnity.title: Professional Indemnity Insurance
professional-indemnity.desc: Civil-liability cover for professional services, written on a claims-made basis.

directors-and-officers.title: Directors & Officers Liability Insurance
directors-and-officers.desc: Cover for directors and officers against claims for wrongful acts in their roles.

side-a-do.title: Side A Directors’ & Officers’ Liability
side-a-do.desc: Excess cover reserved for individual directors and officers.

excess-of-loss.title: Excess of Loss Insurance
excess-of-loss.desc: Follow-form excess layer above a named primary policy, with no automatic drop-down.

management-liability.title: Management Liability Insurance
management-liability.desc: Combined cover for private companies — D&O, employment practices, and more.

financial-services-professional-indemnit.title: Financial Services Professional Indemnity Insurance
financial-services-professional-indemnit.desc: Professional indemnity cover for AFS and credit licensees and their representatives, written to meet ASIC RG 126 and RG 210. Wordings for financial advisers, insurance intermediaries and credit intermediaries are listed on its page.

investment-management-insurance.title: Investment Managers Indemnity Insurance
investment-management-insurance.desc: Professional liability, D&O and crime cover for investment managers, responsible entities and trustees.

cyber.title: Cyber Insurance
cyber.desc: First- and third-party cover for cyber events and data breaches.

crime.title: Comprehensive Crime Insurance
crime.desc: Cover for loss from employee and third-party crime — fraud, theft, social engineering.

technology-liability.title: Comprehensive Technology Liability Insurance
technology-liability.desc: Combined technology professional and product liability, with cyber and general-liability layers.

personal-accident-and-sickness.title: Personal Accident and Sickness Insurance
personal-accident-and-sickness.desc: Capital and weekly benefits for one named person, for injury and, if chosen, sickness, sold through brokers.

aircrew-loss-of-licence.title: Aircrew Loss of Licence Insurance
aircrew-loss-of-licence.desc: Annual, reviewable loss of licence cover for commercial pilots: a lump sum when CASA permanently cancels or refuses a Class 1 medical certificate, and a monthly benefit while it is suspended, built on the Meridian Personal Accident and Sickness base wording.

group-personal-accident-and-sickness.title: Group Personal Accident and Sickness Insurance
group-personal-accident-and-sickness.desc: Capital and weekly benefits for categories of employees, volunteers, players and students, bought by an organisation for its people.

accident-medical-and-hospital-benefits.title: Accident Medical and Hospital Benefits Insurance
accident-medical-and-hospital-benefits.desc: Non-Medicare medical expenses and hospital cash for injury, for exempt groups only (sport, volunteers, students, Australians working overseas, visitors without Medicare), built on the Meridian Group Personal Accident and Sickness base wording.

on-demand-worker-personal-accident.title: On-Demand Worker Personal Accident Insurance
on-demand-worker-personal-accident.desc: Personal accident cover a delivery or other digital platform buys for the people who work through it, while they are engaged on a job, built on the Meridian Group Personal Accident and Sickness base wording.

sports-injury.title: Sports Injury Insurance
sports-injury.desc: Personal accident and non-Medicare medical expenses cover a sporting organisation buys for its participants, officials and volunteers, built on the Meridian Group Personal Accident and Sickness base wording.

corporate-travel.title: Corporate Travel Insurance
corporate-travel.desc: Annual cover for an organisation's business travellers: medical, accident, disruption, luggage, liability, kidnap and crisis, sold through brokers.

expatriate-medical.title: Expatriate Medical Insurance
expatriate-medical.desc: International medical plan for employees of Australian organisations on assignment overseas, and their dependants, built on the Meridian Corporate Travel base wording.

hostile-environment-travel.title: Hostile Environment Travel Insurance
hostile-environment-travel.desc: Travel, medical, evacuation and personal accident cover, including war and terrorism, for aid, media and project staff in high-risk countries, built on the Meridian Corporate Travel base wording.

small-business-travel.title: Small Business Travel Insurance
small-business-travel.desc: Annual business and leisure travel cover for small businesses with up to 20 named travellers, priced per traveller with no trip declarations, built on the Meridian Corporate Travel base wording.

travel.title: Travel Insurance
travel.desc: Single-trip cover for individuals, couples and families leaving Australia, with three plans, sold direct or through brokers.

annual-multi-trip-travel.title: Annual Multi-Trip Travel Insurance
annual-multi-trip-travel.desc: Annual travel cover for every trip in the year up to a chosen maximum trip length, with pre-existing conditions accepted through medical screening, built on the Meridian Travel base wording.

group-leisure-travel.title: Group Leisure Travel Insurance
group-leisure-travel.desc: One policy for a school trip, a tour group or a touring team, with the supervisors covered, built on the Meridian Travel base wording.

inbound-visitor-travel.title: Inbound Visitor Travel Insurance
inbound-visitor-travel.desc: Travel cover for visitors to Australia who are not eligible for Medicare: medical and hospital costs in Australia, return home and travel benefits, built on the Meridian Travel base wording. Not overseas visitors health cover.

public-and-products-liability.title: Public and Products Liability Insurance
public-and-products-liability.desc: Broadform liability cover for injury and property damage caused by your business or your products, on an occurrence basis.

umbrella-liability.title: Umbrella Liability Insurance
umbrella-liability.desc: Higher limits above public and products, motor and employers’ liability policies, with drop-down when an underlying aggregate is used up and cover above a retention where those policies do not respond.

environmental-liability.title: Environmental Liability Insurance
environmental-liability.desc: Contractors pollution and site pollution cover for gradual pollution, clean-up costs that environmental law requires and natural resource damage, which public liability policies usually exclude.

product-recall-and-contamination.title: Product Recall and Contamination Insurance
product-recall-and-contamination.desc: Your own recall costs, replacement, lost gross profit and rehabilitation after accidental contamination, malicious tampering or a government recall of food, beverage or consumer products.

business-package.title: Business Package Insurance
business-package.desc: A modular package for small and medium businesses — property, business interruption, crime, liability, cyber, management liability and more.

commercial-motor.title: Commercial Motor Insurance — Individual Vehicles and Fleets
commercial-motor.desc: Business vehicles from a single ute to a fleet — comprehensive, third party fire and theft, or third party only for each vehicle, with fleet provisions.

heavy-motor.title: Heavy Motor Insurance
heavy-motor.desc: Trucks, prime movers and trailers for owner-drivers and small transport operators, built on the Commercial Motor base wording, with optional downtime, substitute vehicle hire and non-owned trailer cover.

private-motor.title: Private Motor Insurance
private-motor.desc: Private car insurance for individuals, built on the Commercial Motor base wording.

private-motor-pds.title: Private Motor PDS Template
private-motor-pds.desc: Part A of a Product Disclosure Statement for the Private Motor wording, including its departures from motor standard cover, for an issuer to complete.

construction-all-risks.title: Construction All Risks and Liability Insurance
construction-all-risks.desc: Contract works and third-party liability for construction projects, single project or annual, under one joint-names policy, with optional delay in start-up and design and construct PI.

plant-and-equipment.title: Plant and Equipment Insurance
plant-and-equipment.desc: Owned, financed, hired-in and hired-out mobile plant: all-risks material damage, with optional hired-in plant, machinery breakdown and mobile plant liability.

tradies-package.title: Tradies Package Insurance
tradies-package.desc: Liability, tools, mobile plant, small-job contract works, tax audit, payment fraud and vehicle downtime cover for sole traders and small trade contractors, with exclusions set by trade.

industrial-special-risks.title: Industrial Special Risks Insurance
industrial-special-risks.desc: All-risks material damage and business interruption for medium and large commercial and industrial property, with a 67-endorsement library that also attaches to Mark IV and Mark V forms.

strata.title: Strata Insurance
strata.desc: Building, liability, office bearers, fidelity and machinery cover for residential, commercial and mixed-use strata schemes, bought by the body corporate.

commercial-property-owners.title: Commercial Property Owners Insurance
commercial-property-owners.desc: Property, loss of rent, theft, glass, property owners' liability and tax audit cover for owners of commercial investment buildings let to tenants.

landlords.title: Landlords Insurance
landlords.desc: Building, landlord's contents, loss of rent, tenant damage and liability cover for owners of residential investment property.

home-and-contents.title: Home and Contents Insurance
home-and-contents.desc: Home building, contents and personal liability cover for owner-occupiers and renters.

private-client-home.title: Private Client Home Insurance
private-client-home.desc: Accidental damage cover for high-value homes, with contents, valuables, worldwide personal liability, and family protection and cyber cover.

pleasure-craft.title: Pleasure Craft Insurance
pleasure-craft.desc: Accidental damage cover for a privately owned boat or personal watercraft, its motors and trailer, with legal liability for the people who use it, for individual owners in Australia.

marine-cargo.title: Marine Cargo Insurance
marine-cargo.desc: An annual open transit policy for importers, exporters and distributors, built on the Institute Cargo Clauses (A), (B) and (C), with inland transit cover within Australia, transit interruption costs, and optional delay extra expense and stock in storage.

commercial-hull.title: Commercial Hull Insurance
commercial-hull.desc: Hull and machinery cover for Australian domestic commercial vessels on the Institute Time Clauses Hulls, with war and strikes, optional protection and indemnity for passengers, pollution and wreck removal, and Insurance Contracts Act protections given by agreement.

allied-health.title: Allied Health Insurance
allied-health.desc: Combined professional indemnity and public and products liability for individual allied health practitioners.

medical-establishments.title: Medical Establishments Insurance
medical-establishments.desc: Entity medical malpractice for practices, clinics, day surgeries, private hospitals and aged care. Never covers a doctor's own liability.

architects-engineers.title: Architects and Engineers Professional Indemnity Insurance

building-energy-sustainability.title: Building Energy and Sustainability Professional Indemnity Insurance

building-surveyors-certifiers.title: Building Surveyors and Certifiers Professional Indemnity Insurance

education-training.title: Education and Training Professional Indemnity Insurance

geoscience-mineral.title: Geoscience and Mineral Professional Indemnity Insurance

marketing-media.title: Marketing, Media and Communications Professional Indemnity Insurance

real-estate-strata.title: Real Estate and Strata Professional Indemnity Insurance

recruitment-labour-hire.title: Recruitment and Labour Hire Professional Indemnity Insurance

risk-safety-claims.title: Risk, Safety and Claims Consultants Professional Indemnity Insurance

carriers-combined.title: Carriers Combined Insurance
carriers-combined.desc: Goods in transit cover for road transport operators carrying other people's goods in Australia: load cover paid whatever your legal liability, in Essentials, Standard and Comprehensive tiers, with optional legal liability on approved terms of carriage.

equipment-floater.title: Equipment Floater Insurance
equipment-floater.desc: Portable tools and equipment used in a business, insured anywhere in Australia on site, in vehicles and in transit: specified items and a blanket for unspecified tools, with optional hired-in equipment, replacement hire costs and worldwide use.

freight-services-liability.title: Freight Services Liability Insurance
freight-services-liability.desc: Liability cover for freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers and logistics operators, measured by their standard trading conditions, with cargo liability, errors and omissions, fines and penalties, and optional customs duty, public liability and warehouse liability sections.
